note: ADR 0771, 2026-11-23, done: the observed order 1.387 of the cylinder drag on the sequence of ADR 0763 is held down by the first-order wall terms of the wall force integral: replaced alone by second-order ones on the same fields the order is 1.777 (in [1.5, 2.5]); the grading Expansion(50) raises it to 2.906 through the same wall term (a cancellation), and the velocity fixed on the far field leaves it at 1.305 (within 0.1); B0 reproduced ADR 0763 to every printed digit; ADR 0761's 1.38 is 1.51 by the same ratio form.

follow_ups.title: Second-order wall force integral as an option of rcfd-post
follow_ups.acceptance: Every limit not stated here is registered in the ADR before the run. An opt-in wall force in rcfd-post with the pressure extrapolated linearly to the wall and the wall-normal velocity derivative from the wall and the first two cells (ADR 0771, C1), every default bit-identical, exact on a quadratic wall profile to a relative error of at most 1e-9, gives on the mesh sequence of ADR 0763 an observed order of the mean drag in [1.5, 2.5] (1.777 recorded by ADR 0771).
